verdict.rationale: Folk documents a REST API and publishes an llms.txt documentation index plus markdown docs. Neither is a machine-readable API spec such as OpenAPI. A probe of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths returned 404 on every candidate, and no evidence item claims a downloadable spec. The llms.txt and markdown docs are adjacent agent-friendly documentation, not the capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
